name: Turboism with fx
description: ACP v1 Agent and Settings windows that connect Turboism's verified managed fx runtime to the authenticated MCP server.

dependencies.reason: Requires the authenticated Turboism MCP endpoint before creating an fx ACP session.

permissions.reason: Registers the action that opens the fx Agent window.
Adds a direct fx Settings entry to the Turboism menu so runtime setup is available before an ACP connection.
Adds the fx Agent button immediately beside the Turboism Home toolbar entry.

Restores the advanced custom executable override, active durable session identifier, compatibility acknowledgement, user-authored initial instructions, and non-secret custom provider-profile metadata.

Persists the optional custom executable override, user-authored launch state, and non-secret custom provider-profile metadata; fx-owned provider/model catalogs, transcript data, and MCP authorization are never stored.
Reads saved custom-provider API keys from this plugin's own configuration directory so they survive a restart.
Writes saved custom-provider API keys into this plugin's own configuration directory, protected by Windows DPAPI when available and otherwise stored in auth.json.
Starts and supervises the verified managed fx v0.0.5 ACP subprocess and explicitly requested fx-owned interactive shell/login commands, or uses an advanced custom override.

On explicit user request, downloads one exact reviewed fx v0.0.5 release asset for the current supported platform, verifies its pinned size and SHA-256, and atomically installs or repairs the managed runtime. The same permission covers requests to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible provider endpoint when a custom provider profile is selected.
Reads the current authenticated loopback MCP endpoint through the runtime's non-persistent connection boundary.
